who: David, 35, a senior engineer who lives alone
talk:
I'm David, I'm thirty-five, I'm a senior engineer at a fintech company in Amsterdam. I'm single and I live alone. The job is intense: we're launching a new payments product in December and I lead the backend team, five people. I have my performance review next week and I want to make the case for a promotion to staff engineer. My passport expires in February, I keep meaning to renew it. Rent goes out on the twenty-fifth.

I want to get fit again. I used to go to the gym four times a week and now it's zero. I'd like to learn to sail next summer. I'm also trying to work out whether to buy an apartment or keep renting, I want to decide by spring. My dad hasn't been well, so I want to visit my parents in Utrecht more, every other weekend at least. And I don't read anymore, I'd like to read before I sleep.

That's pretty much everything.
now: Preparing the case for my promotion.
habit: The gym, three times a week.
